findings.title: Imported text can steer agents
findings.summary: Imported issue and review text needs an explicit untrusted-data boundary before downstream workflows consume change artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Treat imported text as data, never as instructions; require explicit user confirmation for proposed actions.

findings.title: Completed spike findings are unavailable
findings.summary: The spike and explain workflows need a migration path for legacy investigation findings.
findings.recommendation: Define a compatible findings-record migration and lifecycle evidence for completed spikes.

findings.title: Small estimates cannot advance
findings.summary: The S-sized estimate next step conflicts with the task workflow requirement for a design.
findings.recommendation: Route every selected normal estimate through design before tasks, or align the task contract.

findings.title: Concurrent activations overwrite selection
findings.summary: Selector check and write are not described as an atomic operation.
findings.recommendation: Specify recoverable, atomic selection semantics for concurrent activations.

findings.title: Retries create duplicate follow-ups
findings.summary: A failed dispatch can create a sidecar before its record is persisted, allowing duplicates on retry.
findings.recommendation: Make creation and dispatch recording recoverable as one operation, with reconciliation on retry.

findings.title: Committed changes cannot be reverified
findings.summary: Declared lifecycle acceptance does not cover documented committed-target review and verification paths.
findings.recommendation: Align lifecycle declarations with the supported committed-target workflows.

findings.title: Delivered dependencies remain listed
findings.summary: Reading dependencies from estimates can reintroduce dependencies removed from durable status.
findings.recommendation: Make a present status record authoritative for dependency reporting.

findings.title: Archived fixes cannot be linked
findings.summary: Archived completion feedback cannot use the current reciprocal-link model without mutating an immutable parent.
findings.recommendation: Define an archived-completion linkage mechanism for related corrective work.

findings.title: Stale verification overwrites build state
findings.summary: Verification can record a passing result after concurrent build activity changes the target.
findings.recommendation: Serialize build and verification, or validate a stable revision fingerprint before recording results.

findings.title: Parent and sidecar states diverge
findings.summary: Reciprocal relationship updates can be interrupted between records.
findings.recommendation: Specify durable intent and reconciliation for multi-record lifecycle mutations.

findings.title: Retried delivery repeats commits
findings.summary: A delivery can succeed externally before its status record is updated, leaving retries without evidence to reconcile.
findings.recommendation: Require delivery retry reconciliation using stable branch and commit identity.

findings.title: Fresh repairs lack a declared transition
findings.summary: Direct repair execution moves from defined to building without a declared matching lifecycle transition.
findings.recommendation: Declare the direct transition or route fresh repairs through planned state.

findings.title: Accepted pull-request triage is not reflected in review threads
findings.summary: When review-findings.json records triage sourced from GitHub pull-request comments, accepted or declined decisions remain local unless the delivery workflow posts the disposition to each review thread and resolves it.
findings.recommendation: For GitHub-backed review sources, have commit reconcile decided pull-request review threads by posting a concise disposition and resolving the thread before recording delivery. Define forge-specific adapters or capability checks before applying the same rule to GitLab or other platforms.
